acceptance: The observability tracer omits direct and nested filesystem-path values before local JSONL and OTLP serialization while preserving approved scalar metadata.

Provider-free focused fixtures cover absolute, repository-relative, component-derived, configured-directory, worktree, session, task-record, log, and nested path values, including fail-closed malformed or unsafe values.
Existing tracer and lifecycle behavior remains passing, telemetry failures remain isolated, and no task, process, launcher, evidence-tool, host-adapter, or generic privacy authority changes.
Validation and final expert review evidence are recorded before the exact backlog row and task artifacts are cleaned in the completion commit.
